jobs.name: desktop-remapped
keys: eval:(async()=>{const p=await import('/src/game/meta/profile.ts'),b=await import('/src/game/ui/input/bindings.ts');const profile=p.defaultProfile();profile.settings.controls.bindings=b.rebindKey(profile.settings.controls.bindings,'drive','fire',0,'ShiftLeft');profile.settings.controls.bindings=b.rebindKey(profile.settings.controls.bindings,'aim','fire',0,'NumpadEnter');if(!p.saveProgress(profile,localStorage))throw new Error('Test profile could not be saved');})()
eval@driving:if(document.querySelector('[data-action=fire] kbd')?.textContent!=='Left Shift')throw new Error('Saved driving remap missing or split')
eval@aim:if(document.querySelector('[data-action=fire] kbd')?.textContent!=='Num Enter')throw new Error('Saved aiming remap missing or split')
eval@watch:if(document.querySelector('[data-action=fire]'))throw new Error('Spectating lists unavailable fire action')

jobs.name: mobile
keys: eval@initialPanel:(()=>{const p=document.querySelector('#help'),r=p.getBoundingClientRect(),s=getComputedStyle(p);if(r.top<0||r.bottom>innerHeight+1||r.height<100||s.opacity!=='1')throw new Error('Initial Help panel is not visible: '+JSON.stringify({rect:r.toJSON(),opacity:s.opacity,transform:s.transform,display:s.display,visibility:s.visibility,viewport:[innerWidth,innerHeight],scroll:[scrollX,scrollY],animations:p.getAnimations().map(a=>({state:a.playState,time:a.currentTime,timing:a.effect.getComputedTiming()}))}));return r.toJSON()})()
